{{Top|leg}}
'''El'Tar Miskin''' was the concierge of the [[Greentree Pointe]] resort on [[Dorumaa]].<ref name="LFC">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Miskin had previously worked as a shipping clerk on [[Ipsus]] for [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]], but was fired for negligence, having mixed up a pair of shipments. Apparently, a group of Outer Rim [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] received textiles from Line One, while a Coruscant orphanage was shipped several crates of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] from Line Two. Miskin could have been executed for the failure, if not for his personal charm.<ref name="LFC" />

Miskin enjoyed work that had him interacting with people, especially rich and influential people. His goal was to someday open up his own business&mdash;he was not sure what kind of business&mdash;and he hoped that by currying favor with the resort's clientèle, his charm and knowledge of Dorumaa could gain him investors.<ref name="LFC" />
